topic.para: Almost all output of the help subcommand (do not mix it up with the --help option) opens a text viewer. This text viewer allows you to scroll up or down and read the help text more comfortably. To leave the text viewer, press the Q key.

tip.title: Use tab completion in Bash and interactive shell
tip.para: The &crmsh; supports full tab completion in Bash directly, not only for the interactive shell. For example, typing crm help config completes the word like in the interactive shell.
